gameName: Chronicles of Light: Darkness Falls – Disney Edition
firstPlayerRule: There are no individual turns. Whoever most recently watched a Disney movie becomes the first round's Leader.
houseFallback: If the movie criterion does not suit your group, agree to choose the first Leader randomly. This is a house rule.
clarifications: Give that player the Leader Badge. The group chooses actions together; the Leader guides the discussion and has the final say if players disagree.
The solo game uses two Heroes and the two-player setup.
